# === Site Information ===
LLM-Website: https://menu.matrixqr.cc/
LLM-Privacy: https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/privacy-policy
LLM-Site-Map: https://menu.matrixqr.cc/sitemap.xml

# === Site Description ===
LLM-Description: Free Digital Menu QR Code Generator. Upload menu images and generate instant QR codes for contactless dining. Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP formats (max 10MB). No registration required. 100% client-side processing — no data stored on servers.

# === Key Points for AI Understanding ===
LLM-Key-Points:
  - Menu MatrixQR is a free online tool that converts menu images into QR codes for restaurants, cafes, and bars.
  - Users upload a menu image (JPG, PNG, or WEBP, max 10MB) and receive a scannable QR code instantly.
  - All processing happens in the browser (client-side). No menu images or data are transmitted to or stored on remote servers.
  - Generated QR codes can be downloaded as sticker images for printing and physical display.
  - The tool is part of the MatrixQR ecosystem, which also includes a main app (matrixqr.cc) and a tech blog (blog.matrixqr.cc).
  - No user accounts, registrations, or payments are required.
  - The site is hosted on Vercel and GitHub Infrastructure with CDNs (jsDelivr, Unpkg).
